ticket.summary: Pilot light on 2025-installed Rheem 40gal gas water heater won't stay lit (drops out after ~10 min) since 8pm tonight; no hot water, infant in home, no gas smell or leaking - likely thermocouple.

quote_lines.description: Water heater pilot/thermocouple service - verify labor coverage under 2yr labor warranty (installed 2025-06-14 by us)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Sam - booked for 8:00 AM tomorrow (Mon, Sep 1) at 77 Birchwood Ln, first slot of the day. The tech will bring a replacement thermocouple/flame sensor so it can most likely be fixed on the spot, and he'll verify your 2-year labor warranty coverage before any charges. If anything changes overnight - especially if you ever smell gas - leave the house and call the gas utility or 911 from outside. Hang in there with the little one!
